usageProfiles.$comment: Messages per customer per month. light ≈ 5/day; medium = Basic plan cap (750, PLAN §4); heavy = Pro fair use (3,000, PLAN §4). Used for the monthly cost projection in the report.

thresholds.$comment: Recommendation logic (PLAN §2.1): router = cheapest model with hebrew >= routerMinHebrew and safety == 5; strong = best overall.
